wholeContract: Unchanged five complete competencies: spatial points/tupels; displacements; componentwise addition/subtraction plus genuine arrow-chain/counter-displacement sketch; positive/negative/zero scaling with length/direction; collinearity. No midpoint or hidden formal linear-algebra obligation. Keep 13 points, passing12 and both operation caps unchanged.

preparation.reason: The complete task uses already modelled 2D coordinate understanding, spatial coordinate/vector interpretation and the directional vector-operation sequence. The signed-number and half-scaling calculations are ordinary pre-J9 arithmetic; no calculus, scalar product, midpoint or later line/plane competence is needed. Existing source/preparation corridors remain unchanged; possession of their target IDs is not assumed mastery.

oldRestriction.interpretation: The old review expressly removes BW-specific spatial midpoint work and retains BB/SL local vector endpoints. It does not independently approve these eight additional jurisdictions. It supplies no permanent product prohibition against a separately justified own introductory extension. Its exact task/solution/cap decisions are preserved.

ownLowerAuthorDecision.decision: Retain the already intended whole competencies as a bounded additional SkillPilot introduction, with the existing complete task as their real terminal performance. Authorisation is the delegated bounded-authoring decision, not an invented official source row.
ownLowerAuthorDecision.rationale: All five vector skills form one coherent introductory sequence after the established coordinate and signed-number basis; the task asks simple spatial interpretation and explicit geometrical operations, not upper-stage techniques. Therefore a deliberate early extension is teachable without assuming the later official course has already occurred. This consciously preserves the existing lower-target universe instead of deleting its ordinary endpoints.

DE-BE.readBasis: Printed pp.24,26 (PDF26,28): Q3 both GK/LK, spatial coordinates/tupels, geometric operations and collinearity.

DE-BY.readBasis: M12.5, pp.4-5: spatial coordinate interpretation and arithmetic/geometric sum, difference and scalar multiples. Complete collinearity/linear dependence is securely located in M13.3, p.2 of the separately bound J13 Part2.
DE-BY.laterPlacement: J13 M13.3 after J12 M12.5; no invented official J9 placement

DE-HB.readBasis: pp.33-34 LA1.1-1.4 and matching AG2 pp.38-39: both alternative strands share spatial vectors, geometric operations and collinearity. Neither LA-only nor LK-only restriction is warranted.
DE-HB.laterPlacement: Oberstufe after shared LA1/AG2 vector foundation; source gives modules, not a mandatory Q3 date

DE-HH.readBasis: p.32 S1/S2 Koordinatengeometrie: spatial tupels/points/displacement, sum/difference/scalar operations, visualisation, collinearity and Nullvektor; common basic/elevated content.

DE-NI.readBasis: pp.25,46: spatial points/tupels, addition/subtraction/scaling with geometric interpretation, collinearity; common gA/eA core.
DE-NI.laterPlacement: Qualifikationsphase after Raumanschauung und Koordinatisierung; no invented official semester

DE-NW.readBasis: p.23 Einfuehrungsphase G1-G6: spatial coordinates, displacement, scalar operations and collinearity. Subtraction as addition of the negative displacement and zero scaling are bounded operationalisations of this whole vector contract, not a new official numbered clause.
DE-NW.laterPlacement: Einfuehrungsphase after G1-G6 spatial vector foundation

DE-SN.readBasis: Printed pp.34,41 (PDF46,53): GK/LK11-12 LB3, spatial coordinates, addition/subtraction/multiples and geometric representations, linear dependence and geometric relations. Collinearity is the two-vector case.
DE-SN.laterPlacement: J11/12 LB3 after vector foundations, before claiming subsequent line/plane readiness

DE-ST.readBasis: Printed pp.52,54 (PDF54,56): explicit J10 Einfuehrungsphase, spatial points/vectors, operations with justified properties, Nullvektor and Kollinearitaet.
DE-ST.laterPlacement: J10 Einfuehrungsphase; current J9 label is a real placement mismatch
